annotations.title: List Shopify apps and Chrome extensions with their developers

description: List Shopify App Store apps and Chrome Web Store extensions by category, keyword, or listing URL. Give Shopify category slugs or URLs (marketing-and-conversion-marketing-email-marketing), Chrome categories (productivity/workflow), keywords, or apps.shopify.com and chromewebstore.google.com listing URLs. Each app is one row: name, rating, review count, Shopify pricing line and Built for Shopify flag, or Chrome users and version, plus the developer name, website, registrable domain, address, country, and on Chrome the published email and phone. Apps below min_rating or min_reviews are skipped and not billed. Input with nothing to run comes back as one free row with error_reason input_invalid. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN; Apify charges per app row.

app_urls.description: Optional. apps.shopify.com or chromewebstore.google.com listing URLs to read directly. Always read, outside the max apps cap

categories.description: One per line. Shopify App Store: a category URL or slug from apps.shopify.com/categories, for example marketing-and-conversion-marketing-email-marketing. Chrome Web Store: a category URL or one of productivity/communication, productivity/developer, productivity/education, productivity/tools, productivity/workflow, lifestyle/art, lifestyle/entertainment, lifestyle/fun, lifestyle/games, lifestyle/household, lifestyle/news, lifestyle/shopping, lifestyle/social, lifestyle/travel, lifestyle/well_being, make_chrome_yours/accessibility, make_chrome_yours/functionality, make_chrome_yours/privacy

include_details.description: Default true. Keyword and URL rows always read the listing page

keywords.description: Optional. Shopify: matched against every app name in the Shopify App Store app list. Chrome: matched against the name and summary of the extensions on the categories you gave, or on all 18 categories when you gave none. Every word of the keyword must match

max_apps.description: Most apps per category and per keyword. Default 50, up to 500. A Chrome category page lists about 32 extensions

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before it would charge more than this

min_rating.description: Optional. Skip apps rated below this, for example 4

min_reviews.description: Optional. Skip apps with fewer reviews or ratings than this

stores.description: Which stores a keyword is searched in: shopify_app_store, chrome_web_store, or both. Default both. Categories and listing URLs name their own store
